categories.title: Beginner
categories.description: Foundational, low-intensity exercises to build confidence and strength safely.

exercises.name: Wall Push-Ups
exercises.tips: Great starting point before floor push-ups.

exercises.name: Push-Ups
exercises.tips: Keep body in straight line from head to heels.

exercises.name: Chair Squats
exercises.tips: Use a chair for depth reference and safety.

exercises.name: Marching in Place
exercises.tips: Lift knees high and swing arms naturally.

exercises.name: Bodyweight Squats
exercises.tips: Keep knees tracking over toes. Go as deep as comfortable.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.tips: Engage glutes and avoid sagging hips.

exercises.name: Glute Bridges
exercises.tips: Squeeze glutes at the top for 2 seconds.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.tips: Pull handle to belly button and squeeze lats.

exercises.name: Side Lunges
exercises.tips: Keep chest up and weight in the heel of the bent leg.

exercises.name: Crunches
exercises.tips: Do not pull on your neck; lift with your abs.

categories.title: Intermediate
categories.description: Moderate intensity movements that build endurance, stability, and control.

exercises.name: Mountain Climbers
exercises.tips: Maintain a flat back and drive knees toward chest.

exercises.name: Jump Rope
exercises.tips: Stay on balls of feet and keep elbows close to body.

exercises.name: Battle Ropes
exercises.tips: Generate power from hips and maintain athletic stance.

exercises.name: Hip Thrusts
exercises.tips: Use a bench and barbell for progressive overload.

exercises.name: Russian Twists
exercises.tips: Keep feet elevated for added difficulty.

exercises.name: Tricep Dips
exercises.tips: Keep elbows pointing backward, not flared out.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
exercises.tips: Slight bend in elbows; feel the stretch at bottom.

exercises.name: Cable Flyes
exercises.tips: Slight bend in elbows throughout the movement.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldowns
exercises.tips: Pull bar to upper chest and squeeze shoulder blades together.

categories.title: Advanced
categories.description: High-intensity, demanding movements for experienced athletes.

exercises.name: Burpees
exercises.tips: Modify by stepping back instead of jumping if needed.

exercises.name: Deadlifts
exercises.tips: Keep bar close to body and engage core before lifting.

exercises.name: Sprint Intervals
exercises.tips: Alternate 30 sec sprint with 30 sec rest.

exercises.name: Box Jumps
exercises.tips: Land softly with bent knees. Step down between reps.

exercises.name: Muscle-Ups
exercises.tips: Master pull-ups and dips separately first.

exercises.name: Pistol Squats
exercises.tips: Use a support until you build single-leg strength.

exercises.name: Handstand Push-Ups
exercises.tips: Practice against a wall before freestanding.

exercises.name: Pull-Ups
exercises.tips: Use assisted machine if needed to build strength.

exercises.name: Leg Raises
exercises.tips: Press lower back into floor throughout.

categories.title: Strength
categories.description: Weighted compound lifts to build muscle and raw strength.

exercises.name: Barbell Squats
exercises.tips: Go below parallel and keep chest up throughout.

exercises.name: Flat Bench Press
exercises.tips: Arch back slightly and drive feet into floor.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.tips: Set bench to 30-45 degrees for optimal upper chest activation.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.tips: Brace core and avoid excessive back arch.

exercises.name: Barbell Rows
exercises.tips: Hinge at hips and pull bar to lower chest.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.tips: Feel stretch in hamstrings; keep bar close to legs.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.tips: Break at hips and knees simultaneously.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.tips: Press straight up without excessive back lean.

exercises.name: Smith Machine Squat
exercises.tips: Position feet slightly forward for quad emphasis.

exercises.name: Face Pulls
exercises.tips: Pull rope to face level; externally rotate at end.

categories.title: Cardio
categories.description: Aerobic conditioning to boost endurance, burn calories, and protect your heart.

exercises.name: Treadmill Running
exercises.tips: Start with a 5-minute warm-up walk before increasing speed.

exercises.name: Cycling
exercises.tips: Adjust resistance for interval training benefits.

exercises.name: Jumping Jacks
exercises.tips: Keep a steady pace and land softly on your feet.

exercises.name: Walking Lunges
exercises.tips: Take long strides; knee stays behind toes.

exercises.name: Calf Raises
exercises.tips: Full stretch at bottom, pause at top.

exercises.name: Leg Curl Machine
exercises.tips: Control the eccentric phase for maximum benefit.

exercises.name: Decline Push-Ups
exercises.tips: Feet elevated on bench for lower chest emphasis.

categories.title: Arms & Shoulders
categories.description: Isolation moves to sculpt biceps, triceps, and shoulders.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Curls
exercises.tips: Avoid swinging; control both lifting and lowering.

exercises.name: Barbell Curls
exercises.tips: Keep elbows pinned to sides throughout.

exercises.name: Hammer Curls
exercises.tips: Neutral grip targets brachialis for arm thickness.

exercises.name: Skull Crushers
exercises.tips: Lower bar to forehead; keep upper arms stationary.

exercises.name: Lateral Raises
exercises.tips: Lead with elbows, not hands. Use light weight.

exercises.name: Front Raises
exercises.tips: Alternate arms or use both simultaneously.

categories.title: Yoga & Stretching
categories.description: Mobility, flexibility, and balance routines for recovery and mind-body wellness.

exercises.name: Downward Dog
exercises.tips: Press heels toward floor; lengthen through spine.

exercises.name: Warrior II
exercises.tips: Front knee over ankle; arms parallel to floor.

exercises.name: Tree Pose
exercises.tips: Focus on a fixed point to maintain balance.

exercises.name: Hamstring Stretch
exercises.tips: Keep back straight; hinge at hips, not round spine.

exercises.name: Hip Flexor Stretch
exercises.tips: Lunge position; tuck pelvis and lean forward gently.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow Stretch
exercises.tips: Sync movement with breath for maximum mobility.
